weaknesses.critique: I concluded there was INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE to determine operating margin, but the numeric_checks show computed facts with operating income of $718 million and revenue of $28,046 million for Q3 2026, yielding an operating margin of approximately 2.56%. This contradicts the claim that operating margin exceeded 5%. I should have looked for or requested evidence containing operating income figures, or I may have missed that such data was available in the filing even if not in the specific evidence passages provided.

The numeric_checks indicate the actual operating margin was 2.56% for Q3 2026, which is materially below the 5% threshold claimed. This represents a CONTRADICTED verdict, not INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. The evidence passages I reviewed focused on gross margins and R&D expenses, but I failed to identify that operating income data was available elsewhere in the filing to definitively refute the claim.

The computed data shows operating margin actually decreased year-over-year from 5.78% in Q3 2025 to 2.56% in Q3 2026, a decline of 3.22 percentage points. This significant deterioration in operating margin, combined with E3 showing R&D expenses increased substantially (69% year-over-year to 10% of revenues), suggests operating expenses grew faster than gross profit, explaining why operating margin fell well below 5% despite gross margin improving to 19.6%.
